title.narrative: HINGANA UBUZIRANENGE:Boosting food safety chain in Rwanda

description.narrative:
The general objective of this action is to consolidate food security in Rwanda through strengthening of food safety chain with enhanced use of bio safe agricultural inputs that limits environmental harm and positively impact consumer¿s health.

SO1: To enhance food safety skills of agro-dealers, agri-inputs companies, and farmers.

SO2: To contribute to a relevant food safety regulatory framework and enhance its effective implementation¿

Outputs

1.1 Farmers¿ access and affordability to safe and quality agrochemicals is increased.

1.2 The capacity of farmers to handle and apply agrochemical in target districts is enhanced for safe and improved agricultural produce.

1.3 Strengthened knowledge on biosafety and Integrated Soil Fertility Management (ISFM) among agrochemical dealers and companies.

2.1: Strengthened mechanisms for implementation of food safety standards and regulations.

2.2: Strengthened coordination and dialogue mechanisms between public institutions responsible for food safety standards and regulations.
